files.module_doc:
UnaMentis - Curriculum Engine
Central engine for curriculum management, context generation, and topic navigation
Part of Curriculum Layer (TDD Section 4)

UnaMentis - Curriculum Models
Supporting types for the Curriculum Management System
Part of Curriculum Layer (TDD Section 4)

UnaMentis - Document Processor
Handles text extraction, summarization, and embedding generation for documents
Part of Curriculum Layer (TDD Section 4)

UnaMentis - Progress Tracker
Tracks learning progress for topics including mastery, time spent, and quiz scores
Part of Curriculum Layer (TDD Section 4)

UnaMentis - Sample Curriculum Seeder
Creates sample PyTorch curriculum for testing
This file provides a way to seed the Core Data store with sample curriculum data
for testing purposes.

UnaMentis - UMCF File Handler
Handles reading and writing UMCF files in both raw (.umcf) and compressed (.umcfz) formats
Part of Curriculum Layer (TDD Section 4)

UnaMentis - UMCF Parser
Converts Una Mentis Curriculum Format (UMCF) JSON to Core Data models
Part of Curriculum Layer (TDD Section 4)
